title: APM / HTTP 성능
description: http.server.request.duration (cumulative histogram) — 시리즈별 delta로 요청 수·지연 계산

targets.rawSql: SELECT t, route, sum(delta) AS requests FROM ( SELECT t, route, greatest(0, cnt - lagInFrame(cnt, 1, cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY t)) AS delta FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS t, Attributes['http.route'] AS route, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Count) AS cnt FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY t, route, series ) ) GROUP BY t, route ORDER BY t

SELECT t, route, sum(dSum) / nullIf(sum(dCnt), 0) AS avg_latency FROM ( SELECT t, route, greatest(0, cnt - lagInFrame(cnt, 1, cnt) OVER w) AS dCnt, greatest(0, s - lagInFrame(s, 1, s) OVER w) AS dSum FROM ( SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL 1 minute) AS t, Attributes['http.route'] AS route, toString(Attributes) AS series, max(Count) AS cnt, max(Sum) AS s FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY t, route, series ) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY t) ) GROUP BY t, route ORDER BY t

panels.title: 기간 p50 / p95 / p99 (느린 순) — 버킷 상한 근사

targets.rawSql: SELECT route, total AS requests, if(total = 0, 0, bounds[least(arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= 0.50 * total, cum), length(bounds))]) AS p50, if(total = 0, 0, bounds[least(arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= 0.95 * total, cum), length(bounds))]) AS p95, if(total = 0, 0, bounds[least(arrayFirstIndex(c -> c >= 0.99 * total, cum), length(bounds))]) AS p99 FROM ( SELECT route, arrayCumSum(counts) AS cum, cum[length(cum)] AS total, bounds FROM ( SELECT route, sumForEach(diff) AS counts, any(bounds) AS bounds FROM ( SELECT Attributes['http.route'] AS route, toString(Attributes) AS series, arrayMap((a, b) -> toUInt64(greatest(0, toInt64(a) - toInt64(b))), argMax(BucketCounts, TimeUnix), argMin(BucketCounts, TimeUnix)) AS diff, any(ExplicitBounds) AS bounds FROM otel.otel_metrics_histogram WHERE MetricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND TimeUnix >= $__fromTime AND TimeUnix <= $__toTime GROUP BY route, series ) GROUP BY route ) ) WHERE total > 0 ORDER BY p95 DESC
